info.title: Hekate API
info.description:
Hekate's public API: the calls an API token may make, versioned and stable.

**Authentication.** Send an API token in each call's `Authorization` header (`Bearer hk_pat_…`). A member's token acts as them, within its scopes; a service token acts for the workspace. Each operation names the scope it needs.

**Versions.** This is version 1, under `/api/v1`. Within a version, changes only add: new operations, new optional fields in a request, new fields in an answer, new error codes. Read answers leniently and ignore fields you do not know. Anything that would break a script (removing or renaming an operation or a field, a field newly required, a narrower type) waits for the next version, and a version is answered for at least two releases after the next one arrives, its answers carrying `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers meanwhile.

**Errors.** Every refusal and failure is `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`: act on the `code`; the message is for people. A request that does not validate adds `issues`; a failure (5xx) adds a `reference` to quote to the instance's operator. Every answer carries `X-Request-Id`.

**Limits.** Each token may make 600 calls a minute; past that, `429` with `Retry-After`. Every call is written to the workspace's API log. See https://docs.hekate.studio/use/api/ for the guide.

token.bearerFormat: hk_pat_… (a member's) or hk_svc_… (a service token)
token.description:
An API token, sent in each call's `Authorization` header. Each operation names the scope it needs:

- `files:read`: List and read projects, folders, files, tracks, versions and variants
- `files:write`: Upload versions and variants, make folders, change files
- `reviews:read`: Read reviews, reviewers and decisions
- `reviews:write`: Request reviews and record decisions as the token's member
- `comments`: Read and write comments and their anchors
- `downloads`: Download originals and proxies, watermarked and logged
- `workflows`: Read and change workflows and their runs
- `org:read`: Members, roles and settings, read-only

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before calling again.

InvalidRequest.description:
The request did not validate.

- `invalid_request`: The body, query or path did not validate; `issues` says where and why.
- `bad_request`: The request cannot be acted on as it stands.

Unauthorised.description:
The token does not work.

- `token_invalid`: The token is wrong, revoked or expired, or for another workspace.
- `unauthenticated`: No token, and no session.

error.message: That API token does not work: it may have been revoked, or have expired.

Forbidden.description:
The call is refused.

- `insufficient_scope`: The token does not hold the scope the call needs; the message names it.
- `token_not_allowed`: No token may make this call, whatever it holds.
- `forbidden`: The token's member (or a service token's admin reach) may not do this.
- `workspace_suspended`: The workspace is suspended.

error.message: That needs the files:write scope (upload versions and variants, make folders, change files), which this token does not have.

NotFound.description:
Nothing there that the token may see.

- `not_found`: Nothing there, or nothing the token's member may see, or not part of this version.

RateLimited.description:
Too many calls.

- `rate_limited`: Too many calls; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait.

error.message: This token has made too many calls. Wait a moment and try again.

Failure.description:
Hekate failed. The `reference` leads the instance's operator to what happened (#159).

- `internal`: Hekate failed; quote the `reference` to the instance's operator.
